title: Is this fun? Urchin Skipper Game
author: LucidFir
selftext:
I'm no kind of coder or dev. I was just curious about the tech and what it could do, and thought my job would translate to a game pretty nicely. 

I've tried to keep the boat feel, the pace, the wind and currents, and the psychopathic mother fucking water taxis, accurate to the real world. 

Where I'm gamifying it more is like the quota area unlocks and difficulty increases. I know nothing about UI, progression, rewards, motivation. Got 2 more weeks of astra so, any feedback to take this from interesting concept to something more would be cool. 

Most importantly, does anyone enjoy this?
